<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that matches the described transformation: loss of a ketone and an alkyne (functional groups broken), formation of a C‑C bond and cleavage of a C‑O bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
